page_title: GER 7-1 CUR | Germany v Curacao 14/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Jalal Jayed blows the whistle, Livano Comenencia (Curacao) is penalised for a foul.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' 7 - 1 GOAL - 7:1! Deniz Undav found Kai Havertz (Germany) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Eloy Room off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!

86' David Raum (Germany) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Eloy Room, who tips the ball around the post.
85' Curacao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
83' Here is a change. Joshua Kimmich is going off and Julian Nagelsmann gives the last tactical orders to Waldemar Anton (Germany).
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Gervane Kastaneer (Curacao) coming on for Tahith Chong.
82' David Raum (Germany) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

82' Leroy Sane (Germany) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Germany have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
79' Deniz Undav (Germany) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
78' 6 - 1 What a goal! Joshua Kimmich plays it to Deniz Undav (Germany), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Eloy Room into the left side of the goal. 6:1.
76' Jearl Margaritha (Curacao) fires a wonderful strike towards goal, but it goes over the bar by a whisker.
75' Tahith Chong (Curacao) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and David Raum (Germany) is coming onto the pitch as Nathaniel Brown cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' Here's the change. Felix Nmecha (Germany) leaves the pitch and Leon Goretzka comes on as a substitute.
73' The substitution has been made. Antonio Rudiger (Germany) has replaced Jonathan Tah.
71' The attendance is 68021.
70' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
69' Jalal Jayed sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
69' The Germany players halt their celebrations as referee Jalal Jayed makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
68' 5 - 1 What a goal! Deniz Undav plays it to Nathaniel Brown (Germany), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Eloy Room into the bottom right corner. 5:1.
67' A goal, which was scored by Leandro Bacuna (Curacao), was disallowed due to offside.
66' Jalal Jayed couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Deniz Undav (Germany) and blew his whistle. Curacao get a free kick.
65' Dick Advocaat has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jearl Margaritha (Curacao) replacing Jurgen Locadia.
64' The substitution is prepared. Deniz Undav (Germany) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jamal Musiala.
63' Leroy Sane (Germany) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target.
62' Leandro Bacuna (Curacao) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went a whisker over the bar.
61' Jonathan Tah (Germany) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jalal Jayed blows his whistle for a foul. Curacao are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
61' The free kick from long range, taken by Curacao, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' Germany are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
54' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Germany) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
54' Kai Havertz (Germany) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
54' A quickly taken corner by Germany.

53' Florian Wirtz (Germany) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. Germany force a corner. They send men into the box.
53' Jalal Jayed blows his whistle and it's Kai Havertz (Germany) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
52' Nathaniel Brown (Germany) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.

50' Felix Nmecha (Germany) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball via the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the top of the net, but Eloy Room makes a nice save.
50' Deveron Fonville (Curacao) jumps into a tackle and Jalal Jayed signals a foul. Germany earn a free kick.
47' 4 - 1 Goal - 4:1! Joshua Kimmich laid the ball off to Jamal Musiala (Germany), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Sontje Hansen is replaced by Jeremy Antonisse (Curacao).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' 3 - 1 Goal! Kai Havertz (Germany) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Eloy Room into the bottom left corner.
45+4' Kai Havertz (Germany) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+3' Riechedly Bazoer (Curacao) brings his opponent down. Jalal Jayed has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Germany! Let's see who will take responsibility.
45+2' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Sontje Hansen (Curacao), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Germany) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
45' Nathaniel Brown (Germany) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
45' The corner from Nathaniel Brown (Germany) is intercepted by Eloy Room.

44' Nico Schlotterbeck (Germany) jumps highest to win the header from the corner, but his close-range attempt is well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Germany manage to earn a corner.
44' Germany have a corner.
44' The ball is cleared after Florian Wirtz (Germany) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
42' Jamal Musiala (Germany) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Eloy Room comes off his line to intercept.
40' Juninho Bacuna (Curacao) makes a strong challenge and Jalal Jayed blows for a foul.
38' 2 - 1 Gooal! Nathaniel Brown takes over corner duties. Nico Schlotterbeck (Germany) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
37' The ball is out of play. Germany win a corner kick.
37' Kai Havertz (Germany) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
35' Juninho Bacuna (Curacao) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
34' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Joshua Kimmich (Germany) but poses no threat.
32' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Leroy Sane (Germany) inside the box.
31' Joshua Kimmich (Germany) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
30' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Germany) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Corner kick. Germany will have an opportunity.
29' It will be a corner kick for Germany.
29' Jamal Musiala (Germany) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Nathaniel Brown (Germany) took the corner.

28' Nico Schlotterbeck (Germany) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the roof of the net, but Eloy Room pulls off a decent save to deny him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Germany will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
27' Leandro Bacuna (Curacao) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jalal Jayed blows for a foul. Germany have a free kick.
23' A cooling break is underway.
21' 1 - 1 Goal! Livano Comenencia (Curacao) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 1:1.
20' Florian Wirtz (Germany) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
19' Leandro Bacuna (Curacao) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
18' Jalal Jayed blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jamal Musiala (Germany) brought his opponent down.
17' Jalal Jayed blows for a foul after Jonathan Tah (Germany) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
16' Felix Nmecha (Germany) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
14' Florian Wirtz (Germany) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.

12' Felix Nmecha (Germany) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. His dangerous effort is blocked by Eloy Room, who makes a glorious save!
11' Leroy Sane (Germany) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
10' Florian Wirtz (Germany) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
9' What a chance that is! Felix Nmecha (Germany) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
7' Jamal Musiala (Germany) has a shot blocked from inside the box.

6' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Felix Nmecha (Germany) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the right side of the target. The assist goes to Florian Wirtz and the score changes to 1:0.
6' Jamal Musiala (Germany) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
3' It looks like Aleksandar Pavlovic (Germany) saw red with that tackle. Jalal Jayed won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
2' Florian Wirtz (Germany) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Curacao will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jalal Jayed.
